Hushfeed v0.71.1 has 132 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer, since it's built on patcher 1.15.1.

A small one on top of 0.71.0 from earlier today. With Keep captions in Clear display on, the caption now stays at the height TikTok showed it instead of dropping to the bottom edge (#141). And with Show a LIVE under the status bar on, the strip under the clock is shaded like the rest of the room's top (#137).

Since 0.71.0 went out without a list like this, here's every report the two releases changed something for, and what changed.

Fixed in 0.71.1

* Captions dropping to the bottom in Clear display (#141). The kept caption now sits where TikTok drew it before the controls went away.
* The strip under the clock not matching the LIVE (#137). With Show a LIVE under the status bar on, it's shaded like the rest of the top now.

Fixed in 0.71.0

* Progress bar on videos not showing (#134). It's back on For You, short videos included.
* Videos added to collections won't play (#135). Tapping a saved video plays that video again, and the feed filters leave lists you open alone.
* Animated stickers stuck in comments (#130). They move again. The switch behind it is now called Don't decode animated frames ahead.
* Creator name cut short next to the country (#127). The whole name shows when the row has room for both.
* Double tap for comments sometimes opened the share panel too (#63). A second tap held a moment too long no longer brings up the long press menu.
* Black status bar coming back in LIVE rooms (#137). It stays away for the whole LIVE. There's also a new Show a LIVE under the status bar switch.
* The small share sheet losing Report and Download (#120). Hide the Send to row hides only that row now.
* Puzzle pieces in LIVEs (#87). Protect external pages counts the CAPTCHA puzzle as one of TikTok's own pages, so it keeps its link back to TikTok.
* Passkeys (#102). A new Skip passkey sign-in patch lets TikTok offer your password or a code instead.
* TikTok's language resetting after a reboot (#61). The new Keep the app language patch keeps the language you picked in TikTok.
* The music disc not spinning (#68). Spin the music disc is new under Feed screen, along with Keep the music disc still.
* The button at the top left (#128). Hide feed LIVE button still patches on a build where that button can't be found.
* Progress bar over the creator's name on opened videos (#50). It sits under the caption again.
* Automatic Clear display (#84). Lots here. It clears videos opened from search or a link, the thin line and the loading bar go away with it, Fade the video controls works with it, and back or share no longer turn it off.

Added in 0.71.0 for requests

* Double tap and long press (#136). Double tap can do anything Long press does, and Long press can like the video.
* LIVE quality (#57). Offer LIVE quality in more rooms adds the picker to most rooms that didn't have one.
* Downloading stories (#93). Turn on Save a story from its share sheet under Downloads.
* A seek bar on stories (#72), and an always visible seek bar with a bigger handle and the time (#90). Both got new switches under Playback.
* Keep playing in the background (#99). Replay in the background starts a video over when it ends.
* A comment translate button (#85), and languages left untranslated (#121), where zh-TW and the other Traditional Chinese codes now keep Traditional Chinese.

Added to help track down

* The seek bar preview picture (#140). With Log diagnostics on, the log says how many preview pictures each video came with.
* TikTok's storage use (#70). The diagnostic report lists the biggest folders.
* Joining a LIVE by voice (#132) and the create tab closing (#133). Remove LIVE extras and Remove creation tools now say what they take out, so you can leave them out if you use those.

## What's changed

* With Keep captions in Clear display on, the caption in Clear display now sits where TikTok showed it before the controls went away, instead of dropping to the bottom edge (#141). Before any caption has shown, it keeps the old spot.
* With Show a LIVE under the status bar on, the strip under the clock is shaded like the rest of the room's top again. On phones where TikTok keeps a black strip for the bar, it showed lighter than the stream below it (#137).

## Update

Refresh the Hushfeed source in Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer and patch TikTok again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.

* 3874 runtime tests and 765 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 132 patches applied to TikTok 47.1.4 with desktop CLI 1.18.1. Resource checks passed, and the attached release receipt records the exact bundle and its result.
* This bundle was patched onto TikTok 47.1.4 on a Galaxy S22. With Keep captions in Clear display on, the caption in Clear display sat at the same height TikTok showed it before the controls went away (#141).

- 既存のNG設定と併用できる高度なNGルールを追加。文字列・数値・時間条件、AND、否定、適用する板やスレッドの指定、連鎖NG、通常／透明あぼーんに対応しました。

Hushfeed v0.71.0 has 132 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer, since it's built on patcher 1.15.1.

Most of this one is fixes for things you reported. The progress bar is back on For You (#134), a collection plays the video you tapped (#135), animated comment stickers move again (#130) and long creator names stop getting cut short next to the country (#127). Two new patches keep the TikTok language you picked (#61) and let you sign in without a passkey (#102). The music disc can spin again (#68), Double tap can do anything Long press does (#136), and LIVE quality can be picked in more rooms (#57). Simple mode now picks 115 of the 132 patches. Six patches that used to work with no switch now have one, and it starts off, so if you used Skip the splash ad, Skip update checks, Limit background traffic, Drop the animated image cache, Stop on-device AI profiling or Enable voice comments, turn its switch on after you update.

## What's changed

* With Double tap set to one of Hushfeed's actions and Long-press controls patched in, a second tap your finger stays on a moment too long no longer brings up TikTok's long press menu as well, so the share panel stops opening on top of the comments. (#63)
* LIVE controls has a third switch, Offer LIVE quality in more rooms, under Hushfeed settings > Playback. TikTok offers Video quality in a LIVE's menu only when the stream asks for it or TikTok turns its newer quality picker on for your account, so in some rooms there was no way to pick one. With the switch on, most rooms without it get the newer picker (audio-only rooms still don't), and the next room opens at the quality you picked last until TikTok closes. It's off by default. (#57)
* Show dates on profile grids and Show engagement rate work on TikTok 47.1.4's grids now, on a profile's videos and on Favorites and liked videos too. That version sets each cell's view count in a place the patch didn't reach, so neither the date nor the rate showed up there.
* Blocked creators, blocked words, the view and like ranges and switches like Hide LIVE videos and Hide stories now work on the Following tab too. On TikTok 47.1.4 that tab only lost its ads and place-tagged videos, so a creator you'd blocked could still turn up there.
* A word that isn't a language code in Don't auto translate these languages now gets a plain "isn't a language code" message. It used to warn that no video would ever match, which is the caption language filter's warning and doesn't fit a list that only keeps text untranslated (#121).
* Build details now also names the patches that only change TikTok's resources, like Change app name, Custom launcher icon and Trust user certificates. It lists the patch, never the name or picture you picked in its options.
* With Log diagnostics on, the log now says once per video how many progress bar preview pictures TikTok sent with it. If the preview doesn't show while you drag the bar, a diagnostics export tells whether the video came with any (#140).
* Build details and the full log export now list every patch that changed TikTok's code in your build, by a short name, including the ones with no switch like Comment send fix and Network request report.
* Clear display, remembered or automatic, now also clears a video you open from search. TikTok hands that video to the opened page already playing, and Clear display waited for a start that never came there, so the buttons and TikTok's search bar stayed up (#84).
* Hide video overlays and Feed text sizes now also work when a link starts TikTok straight into search or a video, with no For You feed behind it. Before, the videos opened that way kept every overlay and TikTok's own text size (#84).
* Protect external pages in TikTok's browser now counts the puzzle CAPTCHA that LIVEs and the Shop open as one of TikTok's own pages, so the puzzle keeps its link back to TikTok (#87). It loads from TikTok's own servers, just not from an address the switch knew.
* A quick second tap on Build details, Hook status, Licenses or What's new no longer opens the same window twice, one on top of the other.
* Like the video, as a Double tap or Long press action, now stays with the video you're on in every kind of feed. Where that video has no heart to press, it tells you instead of liking the one next to it.
* A Double tap set to one of Hushfeed's actions now runs it once per tap, even if TikTok passes the same tap to two of its handlers.
* Patching a TikTok version Hushfeed doesn't list is safer. The extras of Show the progress bar and the comment translate button are now left out on their own when they don't fit that version, so they can't stop the patch or go in halfway.
* The Keep captions in Clear display and Automatic Clear display rows now spell Clear display the way TikTok does.
* With Hide the comment bar on opened videos on, the progress bar on a long video you open from search or a profile now sits under the caption again. Before, it drew across the creator's name (#50).
* Fade the video controls now also fades the progress bar on a paused video, the Following tab's stories pill, and on a video opened from search its top search bar, Full screen button and Add comment bar. Before, those stayed at full strength (#84).
* A story can now be saved from its share sheet. Turn on Save a story from its share sheet under Downloads and a save button shows up there. It saves the copy without the watermark when TikTok has one, and tells you when only the watermarked copy is there (#93).
* Show the progress bar has a new switch under Playback, Seek bar on video stories, which starts off. It puts a thin line along the bottom of a video story that you can drag to go back or skip ahead, with the time shown while you drag. Tapping still moves between stories (#72).
* Keep playing in the background can now start a video over when it ends, so you don't have to press Play in the notification each time. Turn on Replay in the background under Playback. A call or another app's sound still pauses it (#99).
* The music disc can spin again. TikTok 47.1.4 keeps it still out of the box, so Feed screen now has Spin the music disc, and Keep the music disc still if you'd rather it never turns. Both need a restart (#68).
* Show the progress bar has two new switches under Playback, both off at first. Show the time beside the progress bar adds the time played and the video's length at the end of the bar, and Bigger progress bar handle draws a larger handle on a slightly thicker line (#90).
* With Hide the Clear display controls on, TikTok's loading line, the thin bar that grows from the middle along the bottom of a video while it buffers, now goes too while the screen is cleared (#84).
* A new Translate button in comments switch under Comments shows TikTok's own translate button next to the comment count. One tap translates every comment and reply, and another brings the originals back (#85). It starts off.
* Clear display no longer leaves a thin line across the bottom of each new video for a few seconds (#84). It was the hairline along the top of the tab bar, which stayed behind when the tabs went away.
* Hide the status bar in LIVE rooms keeps the black strip at the top away for the whole LIVE (#137). It used to give up after TikTok put the strip back a few times, like when panels open and close over the stream. A new Show a LIVE under the status bar switch lets a LIVE reach the top edge with the clock and icons over it, if you'd rather keep the bar. It starts off.
* Double tap can now do anything Long press does, like copying the link or saving the frame, and Long press has a new Like the video choice (#136). A like from a long press works like TikTok's own and never takes a like away.
* A collection or another grid you open a video from keeps every post in it, so Hide photo posts, blocked words and the other feed filters no longer make it play the wrong video (#135). Only ads are taken out of a list you opened.
* Hide the Send to row no longer takes Report, Download and the rest of the actions row with it on the small share sheet a long press opens (#120). On that sheet TikTok puts both rows in one frame, and the whole frame was being hidden.
* Show the progress bar shows the bar on the For You feed again, short videos included (#134). On 47.1.4 it was switching on the wrong TikTok check, one that decides whether a video is an ad, so the bar never came back while a video played.
* The diagnostic report has a new Storage section listing the biggest folders in TikTok's storage, so a report can show what's filling it up (#70). It names folders only, never files, and hides account numbers.
* Pressing back on a cleared video, or opening the share panel from it, no longer counts as turning Clear display off. Opening the same video again clears it like any other, and a remembered Clear display stays on (#84).
* Remove LIVE extras now says it takes out the files for joining someone's LIVE as a guest, so joining by voice or video may stop working with it in (#132). Leave it out if you join LIVEs.
* When Clear display is remembered, or Automatic Clear display has no delay, TikTok no longer shows the tabs under its loading spinner and the first video's buttons for about a second after a cold start. A video opened from Favorites or a profile starts cleared the same way (#84).
* With Show where a video was posted on, the creator's name no longer gets cut short to fit the country when the row has room for both, so "Rn D… · TR" reads in full again (#127). A name that's really too long is still shortened so the country stays whole.
* Hide already seen videos no longer takes videos out of a collection you open, so tapping a saved video plays that video again instead of the wrong one or nothing (#135). It still hides seen videos in For You, Following and Friends.
* A new patch, Keep the app language, adds a Keep the language picked in TikTok switch under System in App (#61). When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops the language you picked in its own settings and follows the phone. With the switch on, your pick stays. It starts off.
* A new Write the username and caption on the video switch in Downloads draws the @username and the first line of the caption in the bottom left corner of videos Hushfeed saves. The phone encodes the video again for it, so those saves take longer and show their progress with a Cancel button. It starts off.
* Remove creation tools now warns that opening a creation tool, like effect search on the camera, can close TikTok (#133). Leave it out if you make videos.
* Drop the animated image cache no longer swaps TikTok's frame cache for one that holds a single frame, which could leave animated stickers in comments stuck on their first frame (#130). Its switch is now called Don't decode animated frames ahead, and turning it on only stops TikTok from decoding frames before they're shown.
* The Following stories bubble at the top of the feed comes back when Clear display ends. TikTok hides it as Clear display starts and used to leave it gone until the feed reloaded. It only comes back if it was showing before and still has someone in it.
* A new Translate into row in Comments takes one language code, like en or es. Comments and captions TikTok translates come out in that language instead of the app's, so you can keep TikTok in one language and read translations in another. Leave it empty to keep TikTok's choice.
* A new Burn-in guard choice under Clear display dims the buttons, caption and tabs over the video to a quarter after 5 seconds without a touch, and your next touch brings them back. With Dim when idle and shift, everything on the feed also moves a few pixels every 2 minutes, so an OLED screen doesn't wear in under controls that never move.
* Hide the comment bar on opened videos now also takes the bar off a photo post you open from search. Before, the Add comment bar stayed on those.
* A new Sound format choice in Downloads lets Save the sound as well and the Save the original sound long press make Opus files (.ogg). They're smaller than TikTok's M4A, and your phone encodes the sound again to make them. It needs Android 10 or later. As TikTok sent it stays the default, so those saves come out the same as before.
* Fade the video controls now works with Clear display. Set between 1 and 99, Clear display keeps the buttons and caption on screen at the level you picked instead of taking them away, and a tap on them goes to the video, so nothing opens by accident. Press and hold or pinch still takes you out of Clear display, and outside it faded controls take taps as before (#84).
* Mute feed videos keeps the feed quiet after you switch TikTok between light and dark. Before, the next videos could play with sound until you left the feed and came back.
* Show how many were filtered and the switches that hide parts of the Inbox keep working after you switch TikTok between light and dark. Before, they could stop until TikTok was restarted.
* Long-press Home for Hushfeed settings keeps working after you switch TikTok between light and dark. Before, it stopped until TikTok was restarted.
* Restoring a backup no longer turns on the Network proxy or replaces the proxy address you already have, so a backup someone else made can't send your TikTok traffic through their server. On a phone with no proxy set up yet, the address comes along with the switch off, and a note after the restore says so.
* Don't auto translate these languages now keeps Traditional Chinese as it was written when you type zh-Hant, zh-TW, zh-HK or zh-MO, while zh-Hans-TW still means Simplified. Before, those entries protected Simplified Chinese instead (#121).
* Hide feed LIVE button still patches on a TikTok build where the side menu button can't be found. It skips that part, and the Hide the side menu button row only shows when the button was found (#128).
* Settings search now finds Build details and What's new. A few results, like Feature Gate Lab and Licenses, now name the group they're in, and a search made only of punctuation says No matching settings.
* The notice that shows at the bottom of Hushfeed settings now closes when you tap it, and the tap no longer lands on the setting under it. TalkBack reads its action as Close.
* Pause now says in plain words what stays while it's on. Your settings stay saved, and so do changes made when you patched, like the app's name or icon. TikTok's Auto scroll is also written the same way on every row now.
* The language lists in Feed filter and Comments now accept an extra comma, like en,,es. They used to refuse the list with a blank name in the message.
* If copying the build details fails, the message now tells you to use Save build details instead.
* What's new no longer shows stray backticks around setting names.
* The time picker for When to send in Keep a streak going now opens dark or light to match Hushfeed settings.
* Skip the splash ad, Skip update checks, Limit background traffic, Drop the animated image cache, Stop on-device AI profiling and Enable voice comments now each have a switch in Hushfeed settings, so Pause turns them off too and Morphe Manager's simple mode now picks them. Each of those switches starts off. If you patched with any of these before, turn its switch on after you update to keep it working. Skip the splash ad, Skip update checks, Limit background traffic and Don't decode animated frames ahead are under Performance in App. Stop on-device AI profiling is in Privacy and Allow voice comments is in Comments.
* New patch, Skip passkey sign-in, in Morphe Manager's simple mode with its switch off (#102). Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so an account with a passkey could get stuck at TikTok's passkey step. Turn on Sign in without a passkey in Hushfeed settings > App and TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys, so it offers its other ways to sign in, like your password or a code by email or text. If you're signed out, long-press Home to open Hushfeed settings.

Refresh the Hushfeed source in Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer and patch TikTok again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.

This release gathers everything since v0.10.0 and brings 88 patches for Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, up from 87. The new one is `Frame step`, which moves a paused reel or video one frame at a time. New switches hide comments with shop links or with words from your News feed list, let Home show just Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages, and save crashes to Downloads so they can go with a bug report. The kept reel progress bar no longer jumps back on the first reel or sits under the caption, Material You reaches the Menu's top card and Log out strip, and the Reported issues list below maps each report this release touches.

New in this release

- New patch, `Frame step`, under Playback (issue #95). With it on, pause a reel or a video and tap the right third of the picture to move one frame forward, or the left third to move one frame back. The middle third plays it again, and taps on a playing video work as before. It starts off, and the report counts the steps each way.

- Two new switches under Comments in `Comment sheet options`, `Hide comments with shop links` and `Hide comments with your words` (issue #118). The first leaves out comments that link to Shopee, Lazada, Tokopedia, AliExpress, Temu, Shein, TikTok Shop or Amazon's short links, replies and all. The second leaves out comments holding something from your News feed `Words to hide` list, unless they also have something from `Words that keep a post`, so the one list now covers posts and comments. Both start off, and the report counts what each one hid.

- `Following feed on Home` has a new row under it, `Home shows`, for people who want Home to be just their friends. Pick Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages and Home asks Facebook for that filter's newest posts, the same ones the Feeds tab shows under it. All, the default, keeps Home as it was. If your Facebook doesn't have the filter you picked, Home shows All, and the diagnostic report counts which feed Home asked for. The choice travels in an exported settings file.

- New switch under Privacy, `Save crashes to Downloads`, in every build and on from the start. When Facebook crashes, the error goes in a text file in Download/Hushfacebook, so it can go with a bug report even when Facebook won't open far enough to reach the settings. It holds the diagnostic report's crash section, with links and IDs left out, and the newest five are kept. Nothing is written while Hushfacebook is paused. The bug form now says where to find it.

Fixes

- A link to a site that isn't Meta's shows up in the diagnostic report's list of screens opened as "(outside link)" and nothing more. The list used to keep the site and the page's path, so a report could name a page you read in Facebook's browser or a file you opened from it.

- Finished-save cards don't pile up any more. The shade keeps the newest twenty "Video saved" and "Photo saved" cards and lets the oldest go. Android stops an app at about fifty notifications and drops the next without a word, which could leave the next save's progress card, Cancel button and all, with no room to show.

- When the phone's decoder gives no sample rate for a reel's xHE-AAC sound, or changes its format part way through, the save falls back to Facebook's single file where there is one and the log says why. The first case used to end in a division by zero. The second would have gone on into sound that comes out wrong.

- Cancel, Pause, Resume, Undo, Add a topic pack, Back and Clear search in the settings show a ripple when tapped. They showed nothing before.

- `Turn off HDR brightness` also asks the phone's video decoder to bring an HDR video down to the usual range on Android 12 and newer (issue #93). Until now only the window was told to stay in the usual range, and a video the phone's own decoder plays, like a VP9 HLG reel, could still light the screen up. A decoder that turns the request down is set up again without it, so the video still plays, and the diagnostic report counts which way each decoder answered.

- With `Tap to play` on, a reel that's waiting for your tap no longer goes into picture-in-picture when you leave Facebook (issue #90). The window used to stay armed from the reel before, so going home opened a floating player for a reel you hadn't started. Once you tap play, leaving works as it did. A reel you were watching in the floating player also keeps playing when you open it back up into Facebook. Facebook pauses it on the way back and starts it again, and Tap to play used to hold that start, so the reel sat with its play button over the time you'd already watched.

- Facebook's push service no longer turns down a patched Facebook (issue #112). On a re-signed build it checked Facebook's certificate, didn't recognize it, stopped and got started again, over and over, and each round could leave threads running, which can drain the battery. It now gets Facebook's original certificate for that check, the same fix HushThreads got for Threads. It's part of every build, whichever patches you pick.

- A save WhatsApp may refuse shows one card in the shade. It has Open and Share like any finished save, says why the video may be refused and adds an `Open the setting` button. It used to post a second card next to the finished-save one.

- Two saves finishing in the same moment keep twenty finished-save cards. Each one trimmed the shade on its own, so they could both let a card go and leave nineteen.

- The Messenger link test under Links writes its result into its own row, where it stays readable. It used to show as a long toast that some phones cut short.

- With `Keep the progress bar` and `Show a reel's time` on, the first reel's bar no longer jumps back to the start while it plays (issue #120). The time above the bar was refreshed before Facebook had checked that the reel's player was ready, and the code that writes the time moves the bar too, so each refresh could put the bar back at 0:00 until the player caught up. The time is now refreshed only after Facebook has moved the bar itself.

- After you pick a different app icon, the `Hushfacebook settings` shortcut on a long press of the icon opens the settings again (issue #119). Picking an icon switches Facebook's usual launcher entry off and the icon's own entry on, and the shortcut still pointed at the one that was off, so tapping it did nothing. It now points at whichever entry is on, and so do the buttons on a notification that open a setting and the Open and Share buttons on a saved file's card. The shortcut catches up the next time Facebook starts.

- With `Default comment order` set to All comments, a friend's post no longer opens with no comments (issue #110). Asking for All comments up front got some posts an empty answer, while Newest and Most relevant got their comments. Comments now open in Facebook's order first, and when the post's sort menu offers All comments, it's picked there the same way a tap does. A post without that choice keeps Facebook's order.

- With `Keep the progress bar` on, a playing reel's caption no longer sits on top of the bar and its time (issue #73). Facebook moves the caption up only while a reel is paused, so it now keeps that paused layout while the reel plays too. Short reels whose bar showed for a moment and then faded out keep it as well. The diagnostic report counts any reel whose bar Facebook still hides.

- With `Material You theme` in dark mode, the card at the top of Menu with your name and picture takes your palette, and so does the strip behind Log out at the bottom (issue #37). Facebook's server sends the card's gray along with the Menu's layout, and the strip loads the gray Facebook keeps for cards as a picture, two paths the theme didn't reach.

- With `Material You theme` in dark mode, the Create story tile at the start of the stories tray takes your palette under your picture (issue #37). Facebook writes that gray straight into its code for dark mode.

- With `Material You theme` in dark mode, the box under a link post's picture takes your palette in the feed as well (issue #37). The 0.10.0 fix waited for Facebook to say dark mode was on, and Facebook lays out the first posts of a cold start before it says so, so those boxes could stay gray.

- In Indonesian and Turkish, the Following feed on Home summary and the Feeds header call the Feeds tab by the same name as the rest of those settings ("Feed" and "Akışlar"). They said "Feeds".

Other changes

- Summaries and toasts call the Marketplace switch's state Marketplace only, like the switch does. Some said "Marketplace mode", which isn't a name you'd find in the settings search.

- The seen posts row is called `Keep seen posts hidden for`, so it makes sense on its own in the settings search. While `Hide posts you've already seen` is off, its summary says to turn that on first.

- Ready for Android 17, which Samsung phones are getting with One UI 9. The reels filters that drop items from a section no longer treat a list the section's class keeps for itself as the section's items. Writing back into one of those is refused once Facebook targets Android 17, and could change every section at once before that. CONTRIBUTING.md lists what else Android 17 changes and why the rest doesn't touch Hushfacebook, and the settings and pause tests also run on Android 17 now.

- `Unlock app icons` says where to pick an icon (issue #122). The icons are on Facebook's own App icon page, at Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon, and the switch's summary used to say only "its App icon page". Patch descriptions in Morphe Manager say the same now.

Reported issues

- #120 Progress bar resetting with Keep the progress bar on: the first reel's bar moves on from where the reel is and goes back to the start only when the reel does.

- #119 Hushfacebook settings not opening from a long press on the icon: after you pick a different app icon, the shortcut opens the settings again once Facebook has restarted.

- #110 Comment sorting: with `Default comment order` on All comments, a friend's post opens with its comments, and All comments is picked in the post's own sort menu where it has one.

- #73 Keep the reel progress bar visible: a playing reel's caption stays above the bar and its time, and short reels keep the bar.

- #37 Material You in dark mode: the card at the top of Menu, the strip behind Log out, the Create story tile and the link boxes Facebook lays out first on a cold start take your palette.

- #122 and #109 Unlocked icons: the `Unlock app icons` switch says where the icons are, Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon.

- #90 Elapsed time on a reel before tapping play: a reel waiting for your tap stays out of picture-in-picture, and a reel coming back from the floating player keeps playing.

- #93 HDR videos with Turn off HDR brightness on: the switch also asks the phone's video decoder to keep HDR video in the usual range.

- #95 Frame mode: the new `Frame step` patch moves a paused reel or video one frame at a time.

- #118 Hiding promotional link comments: `Hide comments with shop links` and `Hide comments with your words` under Comments.

- #112 Battery drain on a re-signed build: Facebook's push service accepts a patched Facebook instead of stopping and restarting over and over.

Behind the scenes

- When the release notes check turns down the phrase about which Facebook builds a release was tried on, its error says the word Facebook has to come right after "to". The 0.10.0 notes were refused once for "to both Facebook" with no hint why.

- The release receipt checks that every patched build keeps its native libraries 16 KB aligned, which Android 17 phones with 16 KB pages need, and records it. A build that isn't stops the release.

- CONTRIBUTING.md no longer names an old release and its patch counts, and the release facts check now holds its patcher version and Manager floor to the pins, the way it does the README's.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 1.34.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `582.0.0.50.54`. On most phones that's build `475417104`, the arm64-v8a one. Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `475417036`, the armeabi-v7a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 2541 runtime tests and 886 patch tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 88 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, both the arm64-v8a and the 32-bit build, and the only manifest changes are the four permission renames that let it install beside Meta's apps. I also patched 582 on an emulator, where Facebook opened signed in with no crash. There the first reel's kept progress bar ran on through two loops without jumping back and its caption stayed above it, a friend's post with All comments set opened with its comments, a Facebook Plus icon applied and the Hushfacebook settings shortcut opened from it after a restart, Frame step moved a paused reel one frame each way, and in dark mode Material You colored the Menu's top card, the strip behind Log out and the Create story tile while light mode stayed stock.

This release moves HushMessenger to Messenger 582.0.0.61.92 and adds seven switches, Auto reply and Use your own font among them.

### Reported issues

- [#29](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/29) Messenger 582.0.0.61.92 is supported now, all 14 arm64 builds of it. 580 and 581 are dropped.
- [#42](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/42) **Auto reply** is new. It answers messages with replies you write, by the words you pick or any message at all.
- [#41](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/41) With **Hide read receipts** on, opening a chat doesn't send Seen any more, and the chat stays unread in your list. Mark as read and Mark as unread work again.
- [#20](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/20) **Hide read receipts** now points to Messenger's own **Read receipts** setting, for when you'd rather have opened chats marked read on your phone without the other person seeing Seen.
- [#40](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/40) **Use the phone's camera app** opens your camera app from a chat's camera button again.
- [#39](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/39) **Use your own font** is new under Theme. Pick your phone's font or a .ttf or .otf file.
- [#36](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/36) **Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages** is new under Conversations.
- [#37](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/37) With **Stop analytics uploads** on, an upload it skips lets the phone go back to sleep right away instead of holding it awake for up to 90 seconds.
- [#30](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/30) With **Hide People You May Know** on, your chats show up sooner after Messenger starts.
- [#38](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/38) **Fix shared videos with xHE-AAC sound** is new. It converts that sound to regular AAC when you share such a video into Messenger, so it can be sent.

### New

- HushMessenger now patches Messenger 582.0.0.61.92, all 14 arm64 builds APKMirror lists for it, and no longer accepts 580.0.0.49.91 or 581.0.0.49.91. Morphe Desktop applies every patch to each of the 14 builds. Messenger 582 looks up some of the names HushMessenger uses to tell its built-in switches apart instead of spelling them out, so the two business suggestion switches now follow that lookup. Meta also reworked the code behind the Settings row in the menu, the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard, the inbox tabs, kept unsent messages, **Save any story** and **Send videos without re-encoding**, and each of those patches now finds its spot in both ways 582 builds lay it out.
- **Auto reply** is a new Conversations switch, off until you turn it on ([#42](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/42)). Tap **Edit replies** under it to write up to 20 replies, each with the words that should trigger it, split by commas. A message that has one of those words, matched as a whole word in any case, gets that reply. Leave the words empty and the reply answers any message. The reply goes out through the Reply button on Messenger's own notification, so it works in encrypted chats too, and each chat gets at most one auto reply every five minutes. Group chats are left alone unless you tick **Answer in group chats too**.
- There's a new **Use your own font** switch under Theme, off to begin with ([#39](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/39)). With it on, Messenger's own text uses your phone's font instead of Meta's Optimistic font. Below the switch in HushMessenger settings you can also pick a .ttf or .otf file of up to 20 MB, and Messenger's text uses that font instead. The row shows just the file's name and whether it's in use. Emoji stay as they are. A change shows after Messenger restarts.
- Conversations gets **Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages**, which starts off ([#36](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/36)). With it on, swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. Scrolling works as usual, and you can still turn disappearing messages on from the chat's settings. It takes effect right away, with no restart.
- **Fix shared videos with xHE-AAC sound** is a new Conversations switch, off until you turn it on. Messenger can't send a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use for some videos, so sharing a saved one into Messenger ended in "Unable to send". With the switch on, Messenger's copy of a video you share into it gets that sound converted to regular AAC before anything reads it. The picture is copied as it is, and videos with any other sound aren't touched.
- **Stop ad attribution uploads** joins the Privacy switches, off until you turn it on. With it on, Messenger's ad attribution job stops before it reads your phone's advertising ID, whether through Google's library or its direct Play services fallback, so the request that sends Meta the ID and your ad tracking setting never gets built. The saved attribution state stays as it was, and turning the switch off lets the next run go ahead as before. The ID itself doesn't change.
- **Stop inbox and ad link logging** is another new Privacy switch, and it starts off. With it on, Messenger skips two reports. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, each time the visible chats change, and Messenger files it under its inbox ads. The other says which ad and business page brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat in Messenger. Only the reports are skipped. The code around them, which keeps track of what's on screen, still runs, and turning the switch off lets the next report through.
- **Hide ad banners in business chats** is new too, under Conversations and off by default. When you start a chat with a business by tapping one of its ads, Messenger shows that ad in a banner at the top of the chat. **Hide chat promotions** never covered it, because it isn't a promotion banner, so it gets its own switch. With it on, the banner isn't added the next time you open such a chat.
- HushMessenger settings has a **Support HushMessenger** row at the end of the App tab. It opens my Ko-fi page in your browser, if you'd like to buy me a coffee.

### Changed and fixed

- With **Hide read receipts** on, opening a chat no longer marks it read or sends Seen, and it stays unread in your chat list ([#41](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/41)). Mark as read and Mark as unread in the chat list work again, and so does Mark as read on a notification. Those show Seen, like Messenger does. Replying in a chat marks it read too, since your reply shows you saw it anyway.
- **Hide read receipts** now points to Messenger's own **Read receipts** setting under Settings > Privacy & safety. With that turned off and **Hide read receipts** left off, a chat you open is marked read on your phone and the other person doesn't see Seen ([#20](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/20)).
- **Use the phone's camera app** now works from a chat's camera button on Messenger 582. That button starts Messenger's camera a different way there, so the switch never saw the tap and Messenger's own camera kept opening. Now your phone's camera app opens, and the photo you take opens in Messenger's editor for that chat. Messenger checks where a picked photo comes from before it opens one, and it refused this photo because the screen that hands it over runs inside Messenger. It lets that one photo through now, and every other file still gets Messenger's usual check ([#40](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/40)).
- With **Stop analytics uploads** on, a skipped upload now tells Messenger right away that the phone can go back to sleep. Before, each upload Messenger started directly could keep the phone awake for up to 90 seconds ([#37](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/37)).
- With **Hide People You May Know** on, HushMessenger asks Messenger for your chat list again about half a second after it starts instead of after 2.5 seconds, to shorten the loading circle that could still sit under your chats for a few seconds. It tries up to three more times in the first 8 seconds and stops as soon as your chats show up ([#30](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/30)).
- **Stop analytics uploads** now also skips the timer that sends Messenger's native analytics batch every three minutes. It leaves crash reports alone.
- **Copy setup** now lists each folder in Messenger's data whose name mentions analytics, with how many files it holds and how big it is, so you can see whether Messenger's analytics pile up while **Stop analytics uploads** is on. It shows names and sizes, never what's in the files.
- Restoring saved choices on Android 9 or 10 now reads the right part of the file when the app you pick it from hands it over as a stream that starts partway in.
- The checks that find the code each patch changes now accept only what Messenger 582 ships. The extra shapes they used to allow for 580 and 581 are refused now, so a build that brings one back stops with an error before anything is changed.
- **Stop analytics uploads** now also covers the way Google Play can hand Messenger's Google Play upload service a task directly, without starting it the usual way. With the switch on, that task is reported back as done right away, so Google Play doesn't retry it, and Messenger's other scheduled tasks on the same worker run as before.
- **Keep a message log** now deletes messages older than 30 days from the saved file itself, a little after Messenger starts and every six hours, instead of only hiding them until the next message arrives. That happens with the switch off too. Off stops saving new messages and keeps the old ones until they expire or you clear the log, and the log's screen now says so. Each message keeps up to 8,000 characters and the whole log stays under 2 MB, dropping the oldest first. If the saved file can't be opened any more (say the phone's key store lost its key), it's moved aside and the log starts fresh instead of failing on every message. A save that fails partway leaves the old log as it was, and **Clear log** also drops messages that arrived a moment before but weren't saved yet, so they can't show up again afterward.
- **Restore old emoji drawer** and the Meta AI tab part of **Hide Meta AI** keep the answer Messenger got when it started, so a change waits for a restart. Their rows in HushMessenger settings now say so ("Takes effect after Messenger restarts", or "Stays in effect until Messenger restarts" after you turn the switch off or pause), and Copy setup marks them with `until_restart`. An account Meta never moved to the redesigned emoji drawer has nothing to wait for, so its row doesn't say that.
- Tapping a row in Messenger's menu after scrolling it now opens that row. Messenger reuses rows as the menu scrolls, and one that had been showing the HushMessenger entry could open HushMessenger settings instead of its own screen.
- With **Material You theme** on, a color that one of Messenger's theme methods just takes from another is now changed once instead of twice.
- **Spoof package version** now refuses a number lower than the Messenger you're patching. The Play Store would keep offering that same release as an update, and the patched app couldn't install over the version it came from.
- **Keep a message log** holds on to messages when a save fails and tries them again first, in the order they arrived. A message dated in the future gets corrected in the saved file too, not only on screen. If you repatch without the switch, the saved log and its key are deleted the next time Messenger starts. On Android 13 and newer the log's screen stays out of the Recents preview.
- **Send photos at original quality** now cleans its copies older than a week out of Messenger's cache. Up to 20 MB each could pile up there before.
- TalkBack can now reach the message log's **View log** and **Clear log** buttons. Buttons that can't be used right now look grayed out.
- The message log now says who sent each message, and in a group which chat it came from ("Ana in Weekend trip"), taken from Messenger's own notification for that chat. Before, entries were grouped under a long chat code. Messages saved before this update show as "Unknown chat".
- When someone unsends a message, the message log keeps the original and no longer gains a second line like "Ana sent a message." for the unsend. That stand-in doesn't get an auto reply either.
- The message log saves each message once. Messenger can build one message's notification twice, and both copies used to land in the log. A message that **Auto reply** answered also says who sent it now, instead of "Unknown chat".
- Restoring choices from a file that can't be read now says "Couldn't read that file" instead of calling it an invalid backup. Canceling a restore partway says your choices didn't change.
- Several lines in HushMessenger settings read more clearly, like the restart hint, the empty search result, the export and import help, and error lines, which now point to **Copy setup** for details. A switch used more than two days ago shows days ("Used 3d ago"). **Chat heads** is written the same way everywhere.
- **Hide Meta AI** now also covers the list that opens when you type @ in a chat. Meta AI and imagine drop out of it, while the people in the chat still show. In a community chat the community's AI entry goes as well. Turning the switch off brings them back on the next letter you type.
- With **Hide Meta AI** on, the search bar above your chats drops its "Ask Meta AI or search" hint and shows Messenger's plain one.
- **Restore screens on re-signed builds** now also answers the certificate check in Messenger's own push service, which reads the signature by itself instead of asking the method the patch already covered. That service matters most on phones without Google Play services.
- **Use system emoji** tries adding Messenger's emoji font behind the phone's up to three times when it fails, since a font that's still being written can fail once.
- HushMessenger publishes its app shortcuts in the background now, so they don't hold up Messenger's startup on a Root Mount install.
- On a Root Mount install, **Copy setup** now says how long HushMessenger took to start when Messenger first needed it, and on which thread. That shows whether it's slowing Messenger's startup down.
- More of the checks that find the code each patch changes now refuse a spot the patch's code couldn't work in, like a register its call can't reach, a field Messenger's code isn't allowed to read, or a static method where it needs an instance, before anything is changed. The patch descriptions also say that the Meta AI tab goes after a restart.
- The release and install check scripts now report a damaged profile record or a signer line without a key with a clear error instead of crashing. Nothing changes in the patches.
- On an install that has no screen for opening your phone's camera app, like a Root Mount install, **Use the phone's camera app** is grayed out and says why. Before, it looked on while the chat camera stayed Messenger's own.
- Releases now run from `scripts/release/release.ps1` in five stages that refuse to run out of order. Each Messenger build family gets patched once per release, and the release checks can wait for a free build slot instead of piling onto other builds. Nothing changes in the patches.
- Extended the app audit with actual Messenger packet observations, background job and CPU measurements, and physically unplugged battery readings. Revision 2 includes aggregate data, a charge-counter chart and a repeatable procedure. It distinguishes shared encrypted hosts from specific tracking operations and documents the limits of short observations on a paused installation. No patch behavior changed.
- Added a detailed Messenger internals audit with ad and tracking paths, native settings screenshots, the boundaries of the 37 controls at v0.22.0, and patch candidates with acceptance criteria. A reusable 581 DEX query batch accompanies the report. The audit identifies a conditional analytics Binder entry outside the existing guards and documents message-log isolation and retention limits. No patch behavior changed.
- The README now points to the patch code, in-app settings, build profiles and catalog checks. It also walks through adding a control or a supported Messenger version.
- **Material You theme** is now in Morphe Manager's default selection, so every control is there without Expert mode. Its switch is under Theme on the Controls page and starts off, so a build patched with the defaults looks like Messenger until you turn it on. **Clone install under another package name**, **Spoof package version** and **Custom new-message sound** still need Expert mode, because they change the package or need a file you pick.
- Every patch description in Morphe Manager now says in plain words what the patch changes and why you might want it. It ends with where to turn it on, or says it works as soon as you patch it in.
- Every switch in HushMessenger settings now explains in plain words what it does and what you'll notice. The pages, the setup panel and the bubble and app icon help text got the same plain wording.
- Messages in HushMessenger settings are clearer. Saving and restoring your choices, update checks, the camera notice and the setup help now say what happened and what to do next.
- The options you fill in when patching are easier to read. Clone install, Custom new-message sound and Spoof package version now explain what to type, and the version code option is called Version number.
- The settings extension's unit tests now always run on JDK 21. On Windows, the Java 25.0.2 runtime bundled with Android Studio made four Android 9 and 10 restore tests read the start of a file instead of the part the provider pointed to. Restoring choices on a phone was never affected.

HushTelegram v0.0.13 has 68 patches for telegram.org's Telegram 13.0.1 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 71679) and the official Telegram beta 13.0.1 (`org.telegram.messenger.beta`, 71669). Sixty-four are selected by default, and every new switch starts off. This release moves to Telegram 13.0.1 and brings twelve new patches, most of them asked for in the issues. You can translate a whole chat, keep a copy of downloaded files and songs in your phone's Download folder, make folders by chat type in one tap, and get notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy. There's also Faster downloads, a black launch screen with AMOLED black, HushTelegram's own icon and name, and switches that hide the Contacts tab, channel bar buttons, the Send as button or messages matching your keyword filters. HushTelegram settings is split into seven pages now.

## What's new

* **Telegram:** New Black and white launch logo patch. With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen on Android 13 and up shows Telegram's own logo in white on black, with its usual animation, instead of the app icon. It's left out of the default selection because it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources, so pick it in Expert mode.
* **Telegram:** New Hide Contacts tab switch on the Chat list page. Turn it on and the Contacts tab is gone from the bar at the bottom of the main screen after a restart, and a swipe no longer lands on its page. Calls or Settings stays as you had it, and the new message button on the chat list still opens your contacts. It starts off.
* **Telegram:** Ask before sending a sticker now covers the stickers Telegram suggests above the keyboard when you type an emoji, in a chat and in a story's reply bar. Those went out on one tap before. A sticker that costs stars still gets Telegram's own question only.
* **Telegram:** Hide blocked users in groups now keeps a blocked person's new messages in a group from notifying you too, not just out of the chat when you open it. It also reads your whole blocked list now. Telegram only loads the first 20 people until you scroll its Blocked users page, so anyone past them used to slip through. And when someone else replies to a blocked person, their reply now shows without the quote of what was said, the way a reply to a deleted message looks.
* **Telegram:** A wording pass. Pause is explained the same way everywhere, Import settings says what a file holds, and errors that left you guessing now say what to do next: download a damaged file again, update HushTelegram for a file from a newer one, or open an export that couldn't be checked.
* **Telegram:** With Debug logging on, what HushTelegram writes to Android's log goes through the same redaction as an exported report, so tokens and keys in a message or an error stay out of it.
* **Telegram:** The App name option turns down direction marks and zero-width characters, which could flip or hide the name under the icon. Emoji built with zero-width joiners still work, and so do Persian, Kurdish and Indic names that need the zero-width non-joiner.
* **Telegram:** Export diagnostic report says "Preparing the diagnostic report" while it builds the report and takes no second tap until the copy or the file is done. The back arrow and the name at the top use the page's own white, and the back arrow shows when a keyboard is on it.
* **Telegram:** A keyboard or D-pad gets into the list as soon as settings opens, stops on the status card and on the paused page's status line, where Enter presses their Pause, Resume or Undo button, and a ring shows which row it's on. The two Export diagnostic report choices read as buttons to a screen reader, and a ring marks the one a keyboard is on.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram's own dialogs in a chat (Message details, Forward to, the Ask before questions) now go light or dark with Telegram's theme. Before, they followed the phone's dark mode, so they could come out white over Telegram's Night theme.
* **Telegram:** Import settings now lists every switch the file changes and which way it goes, like "Hide ads turns off", under the count. A file someone shared with you can't quietly turn off Stop usage reports anymore.
* **Telegram:** When Telegram turns down the API ID your build signs in with, the phone number screen now says so, with a button that opens the guide to using your own ID. Before, it just sat there after you tapped the arrow. This covers API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD, the built-in ID being refused, and API_ID_INVALID, a registered ID or hash with a typo in it. Reported in #11 and #3.
* **Telegram:** Keep deleted messages remembers the newest 5,000 kept messages per account. Past that, the oldest ones now go to Telegram's own deletion, the way they would have without the switch. Before, they stayed in the chat without their deleted label, where Clear kept messages couldn't reach them. If Telegram can't take some of them back, they stay kept and are first in line next time, so newer kept messages aren't pushed out early. Clear kept messages also can't hand the same message over twice when another one is kept at that moment, so its count stays right.
* **Telegram:** Messages that pop up at the bottom of the screen are shorter now, so Android shows them whole instead of cutting them off after two lines.
* **Telegram:** The Export settings row now says what a file carries (your switches, filter lists and sticker size) and which switches stay out of it.
* **Telegram:** A new Folders by chat type switch on the Chat list page, off by default, makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're ordinary Telegram folders, made the way Telegram's own folder screen makes them, so they show as tabs above the chat list right away and reach your other devices. Private takes in your contacts and everyone else. A type you already have a folder for is skipped, and Telegram's folder limit is kept, with a toast that says when it left no room. Turning the switch off removes the folders it made. One you've renamed, given an emoji, or added, left out or pinned chats in is yours and stays. A color doesn't count, since Telegram gives each new folder one of its own. If nothing can be done (HushTelegram is paused, you're signed out, or Telegram is still loading your folders) the switch goes back and a toast says why. The switch isn't in settings backups, since importing it wouldn't make or remove anything. Asked for in #7.
* **Telegram:** A new Save downloaded files switch on the Playback page, off by default, puts a copy of each file and song you download in Download/Telegram on your phone, the folder Telegram's own Save to Downloads uses. File managers, music players and other apps can open them there. It covers documents and songs. Photos and videos already have Telegram's Save to gallery settings, and GIFs, voice messages and round videos stay in Telegram. So does anything from a secret chat, self-destructing media, and chats or messages that don't allow saving. A file that's already there with the same name and size isn't copied twice. A name with hidden text-direction marks in it, or one too long for the file system, is cleaned up so the copy still lands. On Android 9, and on Android 10 when Telegram has storage access, Telegram's own folder is already open to other apps, so nothing is copied. Asked for in #7.
* **Telegram:** A new UnifiedPush notifications switch on the Notifications page, off by default, is for phones where Firebase notifications don't come through. Install a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, turn the switch on, and Telegram signs up the address that app gives it, through the Simple push type Telegram's own API has for this. Telegram's servers call that address when something arrives, the app wakes Telegram, and Telegram fetches the message itself, so only the wake-up passes through the UnifiedPush app. The Push app row under the switch shows how the sign-up is going, and reads it again when you come back to Telegram, so a sign-up the app ended while you were away shows as ended. The sign-up reaches ntfy even if you haven't opened it since installing it. With more than one UnifiedPush app installed and no ntfy among them, you pick which one gets the sign-up. Turning it off ends the sign-up and has Telegram ask Firebase again right away. Uninstalling the UnifiedPush app does the same at the next start. The switch isn't in settings backups, so a file someone shared can't route your wake-ups through another app. Asked for in #5.
* **Telegram:** Translate with an outside service can now use an AI service with your own key instead of Google's web translate. Tap Translation service under the switch and fill in the address, model and key. Anything that takes OpenAI's chat format works, like OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Groq or Gemini's OpenAI address. The key stays on your phone: it isn't in settings backups, the diagnostic report or the log, and it only goes over https (plain http is allowed just for a model server on the phone itself). A message already in your language stays as it is, and if the service turns your key down you'll get a toast that says so. A redirect from the service isn't followed, so the text and the key only ever go to the address you typed. Use Google in the same dialog goes back and forgets the key. Asked for in #2.
* **Telegram:** A new Faster downloads switch on the Playback page, off by default, has files download in 512 KB pieces with 8 requests at a time instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. That's the setting Telegram already uses for accounts its servers pick for it, so it isn't a Premium unlock, and the servers still decide how fast they send. If a big piece fails, Telegram drops back to small ones on its own like before. It applies from the next download, no restart needed. Asked for in #6.
* **Telegram:** A new HushTelegram icon and name patch puts HushTelegram's own badge on your home screen, with a themed version that takes your wallpaper's color on Android 13 and up. Its one option changes the name under the icon. It isn't selected by default, since there's no switch to undo it after patching: turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick it. An alternate icon you chose in Telegram's own settings keeps its look. Asked for in #6.
* **Telegram:** AMOLED black now turns the launch screen black too, on Android 13 and up while your phone is in dark mode, so Telegram no longer opens on its dark blue screen before the black one. It's Android's own black screen with Telegram's icon on it, so nothing is added to Telegram's resources. Turning AMOLED black off or pausing HushTelegram brings Telegram's own back the next time it starts. Asked for in #6.
* **Telegram:** A new Translate with an outside service switch, off by default, adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. The text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. Turning the switch off forgets the chats and messages you'd turned on, so switching it back on later sends nothing until you choose again. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks aren't touched.
* **Telegram:** Two new switches on the Look and feel page, both off by default. Hide channel bar buttons takes Search, Direct messages and Info out of the bar at the bottom of a channel and leaves Mute and Join. Gift already goes with Hide Premium, gifts and Stars, and a channel's Recent actions log keeps its own Search. Hide Send as button hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, but only while you're posting as yourself, so you'll always see it when a message would go out under a channel's name.
* **Telegram:** A new Hide messages by keyword switch on the Conversations page, off by default, with a list of filters for groups and another for channels. A filter is one line: plain text matches wherever it appears in a message, and a line in slashes like /crypto|airdrop/ is a regular expression. Neither minds capital letters. Matching messages are left out of a chat when you open it, the way Telegram leaves out a message it can't show, so nothing is deleted and the server never hears about it. Private chats and your own messages are never filtered. The editor refuses a line it can't use and says which one, including an expression that could take too long on a long message, and it won't keep a list too big to carry in a settings file. Settings export carries both lists, and an older HushTelegram leaves them out of an import rather than refusing the file.
* **Telegram:** Hide Premium, gifts and Stars now also covers Premium stickers if you don't have Premium. They're left out of sticker packs, the sticker keyboard and its favorites and recents, the way Telegram leaves them out where Premium can't be sold, and a Premium sticker someone sends you no longer plays its full-screen effect or pops up the Premium tooltip. The sticker itself still shows in the chat. The emoji keyboard drops locked emoji packs too, so the emoji tab only lists emoji you can send, and a Premium pack with some free emoji keeps those. With Premium, nothing changes.
* **Telegram:** A new Change sticker size switch on the Look and feel page, off by default, with a Sticker size row under it. Pick 50%, 75%, 125% or 150% of the size Telegram gives a sticker in a chat, and a chat shows the new size the next time you open it. Animated emoji and dice keep their own size. Settings export carries the size you picked, and an import refuses a size that isn't one of the four.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram settings no longer puts about 55 switches on one Chats page. They're now on Ads, Chat list, Conversations, Playback, Notifications, Look and feel and Privacy, the same groups Morphe Manager sorts the patches into, and each patch's description names its page. Hide phone number and Turn off beta debug logs moved to Privacy. Your saved choices don't change, and search still finds every switch.
* **Telegram:** The two longest settings pages, Conversations and Look and feel, are now split under short headings like Translation or Theme, each group in a card of its own, so a switch is easier to find than in one long list of thirty. Switch rows also dropped the icon they all repeated, which gives their text the full width. Asked for in #6.
* **Telegram:** Telegram 13.0.1 is now the supported version, both telegram.org's build (version code 71679) and the official beta (71669). Every patch is checked against those two builds, and 12.10.6 and 12.10.7 are no longer supported.

### Tooling

* **Tooling:** The source ledger is caught up with the October 11 audit (new sources, moved pins, 397 forks), and the census is fresh again. Sources hosted somewhere other than GitHub or GitLab now get their own list with the version an index last showed, so the audit stops flagging one it can't read and speaks up again when a new version appears.
* **Tooling:** The settings screen's code is split into one method per page, and patch helpers nothing called anymore are gone. The release script keeps gh's warnings out of what it publishes, and the release receipt stops on a clone git can't open instead of reading it as a copy with no history.
* **Tooling:** The selection matrix expects the Firebase crash and session report switches only on a build that ships those SDKs, which is Telegram Beta. It also rebuilds the one call Turn off beta debug logs adds to Telegram's startup settings the way the patcher adds it, so a default build no longer fails there, while a call in the wrong place, on the wrong register or added twice still does. With HushTelegram icon and name in the selection, it expects the app and Telegram's default launcher entry to point at the icon that patch adds, and nothing else in the manifest to change.
* **Tooling:** The selection matrix no longer fails every selection that includes Save downloaded files. That patch has the patcher rewrite one of Telegram's classes, which drops two values set to zero and false, and a field left without a value starts at zero or false anyway. The check now reads those as the same, and a real value that goes missing still fails it.
* **Tooling:** The source audit reads the Morphe Patch Tracker again. The tracker now names some bundles twice in different case, like `ImmortalZeus:dev` and `immortalzeus:dev`, and PowerShell couldn't hold both, so the whole source failed. Files like that are now read with case kept, and both bundles count.
* **Tooling:** The source audit reads Jman's bundle index again. It moved to `Jman-Github/Patch-Bundle-Registry`, and the bundle list and patch catalog the audit used to read are gone. The audit now reads the registry's own snapshot: the newest generation, every latest bundle that targets Telegram, and the Telegram patches in each. The ledger points at the registry and at HushTelegram's listing there.
* **Tooling:** Awesome Morphe lists HushTelegram now, so the ledger records the listing and the release check stops calling it pending.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Get Telegram 13.0.1, version code 71679, from telegram.org's [Download button](https://telegram.org/android). The official beta 13.0.1, build 71669, works too. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from v0.0.12? That one was built for 12.10.6, so patch the new 13.0.1 APK and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put one over the other. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram won't send you a login code, register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps). Use only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select `Use registered Telegram API credentials`, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications and Sounds, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection. Phones where Firebase notifications don't come through can also try the new UnifiedPush notifications switch on HushTelegram's Notifications page with a UnifiedPush app like ntfy.
8. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

## 1.1.0 (2026-10-11)

Two new patches that remove the app's screenshot restrictions. Everything from 1.0.0 is unchanged
and the bundle still installs over the previous build (same keystore, data preserved).

### Patches

- **Allow screenshots.** `WavesActivity` - the app's generic in-app WebView (it takes a `url` and
  `headers` extra, so every page routed through it inherits this) applies `FLAG_SECURE` in
  `onCreate`, which made screenshots of those pages come out black. The patch rewrites that call
  into `clearFlags`, and neuters the bundled `no_screenshot` Flutter plugin's own `FLAG_SECURE`
  hook (`screenshotOff`, `toggleScreenshot`, `screenshotWith*`) so no screen can re-apply it.
- **Hide screenshot detection.** The same plugin registers a MediaStore `ContentObserver` that
  reports every newly saved image to the Flutter layer as a "screenshot taken" event. The patch
  returns early from the registration, so detection is never active.

### Notes

- On Motorola firmware the platform still writes the PNG while `FLAG_SECURE` is set, compositing
  the secure layer black, so the user-visible bug was a *black screenshot* rather than a "can't
  take screenshot" refusal - a screenshot file existing is not proof that the flag is gone.
- Verified on RailOne 2.1.66 (versionCode 237), arm64, Moto Edge 50 Neo / Android 16: screenshots
  of the Home, PNR and in-app WebView screens all come out with real content, and no detection
  event is logged.
- `MainActivity` does not set `FLAG_SECURE` on any screen tested. The app's Protectt RASP SDK has
  its own capture hooks and rule-driven appliers, but none were active, so they are deliberately
  left unpatched rather than half-covered.

Hushfeed v0.71.2 has 132 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer, since it's built on patcher 1.15.1.

One more for #137, reported right after 0.71.1 went out. A LIVE you open from the preview under a creator's card in search now gets Hide the status bar in LIVE rooms and Show a LIVE under the status bar too. TikTok opens that LIVE inside the page it uses for opened videos, and the switches never reached it there.

Here's every report the last three releases changed something for, and what changed.

Fixed in 0.71.2

* The status bar switches doing nothing on a LIVE opened from search (#137). They work there now, and swiping on to a video gives the bar back the way TikTok had it.

Fixed in 0.71.1

* Captions dropping to the bottom in Clear display (#141). The kept caption now sits where TikTok drew it before the controls went away.
* The strip under the clock not matching the LIVE (#137). With Show a LIVE under the status bar on, it's shaded like the rest of the top now.

Fixed in 0.71.0

* Progress bar on videos not showing (#134). It's back on For You, short videos included.
* Videos added to collections won't play (#135). Tapping a saved video plays that video again, and the feed filters leave lists you open alone.
* Animated stickers stuck in comments (#130). They move again. The switch behind it is now called Don't decode animated frames ahead.
* Creator name cut short next to the country (#127). The whole name shows when the row has room for both.
* Double tap for comments sometimes opened the share panel too (#63). A second tap held a moment too long no longer brings up the long press menu.
* Black status bar coming back in LIVE rooms (#137). It stays away for the whole LIVE. There's also a new Show a LIVE under the status bar switch.
* The small share sheet losing Report and Download (#120). Hide the Send to row hides only that row now.
* Puzzle pieces in LIVEs (#87). Protect external pages counts the CAPTCHA puzzle as one of TikTok's own pages, so it keeps its link back to TikTok.
* Passkeys (#102). A new Skip passkey sign-in patch lets TikTok offer your password or a code instead.
* TikTok's language resetting after a reboot (#61). The new Keep the app language patch keeps the language you picked in TikTok.
* The music disc not spinning (#68). Spin the music disc is new under Feed screen, along with Keep the music disc still.
* The button at the top left (#128). Hide feed LIVE button still patches on a build where that button can't be found.
* Progress bar over the creator's name on opened videos (#50). It sits under the caption again.
* Automatic Clear display (#84). Lots here. It clears videos opened from search or a link, the thin line and the loading bar go away with it, Fade the video controls works with it, and back or share no longer turn it off.

Added in 0.71.0 for requests

* Double tap and long press (#136). Double tap can do anything Long press does, and Long press can like the video.
* LIVE quality (#57). Offer LIVE quality in more rooms adds the picker to most rooms that didn't have one.
* Downloading stories (#93). Turn on Save a story from its share sheet under Downloads.
* A seek bar on stories (#72), and an always visible seek bar with a bigger handle and the time (#90). Both got new switches under Playback.
* Keep playing in the background (#99). Replay in the background starts a video over when it ends.
* A comment translate button (#85), and languages left untranslated (#121), where zh-TW and the other Traditional Chinese codes now keep Traditional Chinese.

Added to help track down

* The seek bar preview picture (#140). With Log diagnostics on, the log says how many preview pictures each video came with.
* TikTok's storage use (#70). The diagnostic report lists the biggest folders.
* Joining a LIVE by voice (#132) and the create tab closing (#133). Remove LIVE extras and Remove creation tools now say what they take out, so you can leave them out if you use those.

## What's changed

* Hide the status bar in LIVE rooms and Show a LIVE under the status bar now work on a LIVE opened from the preview under a creator's card in search too. TikTok opens that LIVE inside the page it uses for opened videos, which the switches didn't reach (#137).

## Update

Refresh the Hushfeed source in Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer and patch TikTok again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.

## Checked

* 3876 runtime tests and 765 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 132 patches applied to TikTok 47.1.4 with desktop CLI 1.18.1. Resource checks passed, and the attached release receipt records the exact bundle and its result.
* This bundle was patched onto TikTok 47.1.4 on a Galaxy S22, and a LIVE was opened from the preview under a creator's card in search (#137). With Show a LIVE under the status bar on, the LIVE reached the top with the creator row below the clock. With Hide the status bar in LIVE rooms on, the bar went away. Swiping on to the next video brought TikTok's own layout and the bar back both times.

## [0.0.9](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/compare/v0.0.8...v0.0.9) (2026-10-11)

### Features

* **Instagram - Lock your messages:** New Unlock with choice. Pick HushGram PIN and a 4 to 8 digit PIN of your own unlocks your messages instead of your phone's lock. It stays on your phone and can't be recovered. Asked for in #134.

* **Instagram - Download any video:** New switch under Downloads, Hold to download, off by default. Hold two fingers on a feed post or a reel for a second and it saves what's under them. Instagram's one-finger long press doesn't change.

* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** New switch under Tab bar, Center the logo on Home's header, off by default. Instagram's logo sits in the middle of Home's top bar without the newer header's other changes. Asked for in #50.
